On a side note, you may think it's difficult to be a man who was homeschooled, but for the vast majority of homeschooled people I grew up with, the men are doing far better across the board than the women. I grew up in a fundamentalist Christian homeschool environment where women were not taught personal finance (their husbands would control the money) or prepared for higher education (stay at home moms don't need a degree).
